cards.card_text: Then the LORD gives Moses rules for a census: each man twenty or older who is counted pays the LORD a ransom for his life, the same half shekel for rich and poor.
cards.verse_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “When you take a census of the Israelites to number them, each man must pay the LORD a ransom for his life when he is counted.

cards.card_text: It's EVERYBODY twenty years of age or older who was counted in the census, and none of them will enter the land except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
cards.verse_text: Your bodies will fall in this wilderness—all who were numbered in the census, everyone twenty years of age or older—because you have grumbled against Me.

cards.card_text: In those days, Caesar Augustus, the Roman emperor, sends out a decree to take a census of the whole empire.
cards.verse_text: Now in those days a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that a census should be taken of the whole empire.
